stock.description: Fulu Holdings Limited, an investment firm, manages a prominent third-party platform for digital merchandise and services throughout the People's Republic of China. Its operations are structured across four key divisions: Leisure and Entertainment, Gaming, Telecommunications, and Lifestyle. Central to its model, the company's platform acts as an intermediary, linking digital product suppliers with diverse sales and distribution channels. Fulu delivers essential services to streamline digital goods transactions and provides online store operational support to a wide array of partners, including leisure and entertainment content creators, game developers, telecommunication companies, and lifestyle service providers. Beyond this, the firm also hosts and manages e-commerce storefronts directly for digital goods vendors. Established in 2009, Fulu Holdings Limited maintains its headquarters in Wuhan, China.
